instruction: I want to save the subtitle text from this video as a separate file. Extract the subtitles and save them to "/home/user/subs.srt".

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting subtitles from video.mp4 and saving as subs.srt. Evaluator verifies file exists and is non-empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks file existence and non-empty status, not actual subtitle extraction
Cannot verify if file content is valid SRT subtitle format
Cannot verify if content was actually extracted from video.mp4 (user could create any non-empty file)
Missing semantic verification: any non-empty file at the path would pass, even 'echo hello > subs.srt'
Does not validate subtitle format structure (timecodes, subtitle text, SRT syntax)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add SRT format validation: check for timecode patterns (e.g., '00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000')
Verify file contains multiple subtitle entries (not just random text)
Consider checking file size is reasonable for subtitle content (e.g., > 100 bytes)
Add basic content validation: presence of newlines, numeric sequences, arrow separators typical of SRT format
Alternative: Use official metrics that can validate subtitle file structure if available
